label: GOD_4 exists: there is something that is GOD_4, in the sense of the GOD_4 of…, from prima via
meaning: Stage 1 from the prima via: the First Way conclusion reaches 'God exists' only with four open gap premises: excluded middle for the first-mover proposition, uniqueness, pure act, and identification with the God of classical theism.

strong_version_needed.c1b68c21-fa36-5ab0-a499-444259eda78a: For this exact encoded interface, the finite weak model satisfies the relative conclusion, the particular excluded-middle instance, uniqueness and both conditional identification/pure-act bridges, yet its IsGod predicate can be false; these bridges classify absolute first movers, not relative ones. Checked by PRIMA-VIA-WEAK-CONSUMER-BOUNDARIES. This scope does not extend to arbitrary added attribute/historical premises, nor establish the strong premise philosophically. See docs/notes/prima-via-strength-consumers.md.
